text:
Type: brass sputnik-style chandelier
Use: statement light over a dining table; dining room, living room
Style: mid-century modern, modern, glam
Materials: antique brass metal, exposed clear bulbs
Colors: warm brass gold, clear
Shape: three adjustable crossing arms on central rod, six bare globe bulbs at the ends, hangs on cord, wide, linear and open
Feel: sculptural, warm, lively
Goes with: walnut wood, dark walls, white or green tones; mid-century or modern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century Modern 6-Light Ceiling Pendant Chandelier Fixture, 29.3"W, Adjustable Hanging Height, Brass
product.description: This mobile-style 6-light chandelier is sure to turn heads upward. Three brass arms, each with clear glass orbs on the ends, are presented in tri-level style. This beautiful statement piece adds a touch of glam to a modern or industrial style room. 29.3"W x 6.5"D x 80"H, Hanging Length: 60" Metal with brass finish; glass orb shades Included rods allow you to adjust the height Bulbs not included Professional hardwiring recommended Intended for indoor use only
